title: Windows Screensaver Files and RMM Persistence
author: sonny
description: This is a simple emulation of a campaign documented by ReliaQuest, 'New Campaign Uses Screensavers for RMM-Based Persistence'. LimeWire.com is used to deliver a self-extracting archive masquerading as a Windows screensaver file that installs ScreenConnect.
body:
This is a simple emulation of a campaign documented by ReliaQuest, 'New Campaign Uses Screensavers for RMM-Based Persistence'. LimeWire.com is used to deliver a self-extracting archive masquerading as a Windows screensaver file that installs ScreenConnect.

See https://detection.wiki/labs/windows-screensaver-files-and-rmm-persistence/ for full KQL queries and telemetry walkthrough.
